purpose: Close the tempting continuation 'raise the explicit multilinear Macaulay degree until the formula refutes'. Fixed degree is polynomial but incomplete; any unbounded degree schedule makes the full explicit squarefree-monomial coordinate space superpolynomial. Therefore a universal polynomial continuation, if it exists, must compress unbounded-degree information rather than enumerate all monomials through a growing degree.

explicit_space.definition: V_d is the multilinear GF(2) vector space on all squarefree monomials of degree at most d in n Boolean variables.
explicit_space.model_scope: The barrier applies to algorithms that explicitly materialize the full V_d coordinate basis or an equivalent state with at least one independent coordinate per squarefree monomial through degree d.

theorem.name: UNBOUNDED_EXPLICIT_MACAULAY_DEGREE_FORCES_SUPERPOLYNOMIAL_STATE
theorem.statement: Let d(n) be any integer-valued unbounded degree schedule with 1<=d(n)<=n. Then M(n,d(n)) is not bounded by n^C for any fixed constant C along all sufficiently large n. Hence no algorithm polynomial in the explicit V_d dimension can remain polynomial for an unbounded degree schedule.
proof: Put k(n)=min(d(n), floor(sqrt(n))). Since d(n) is unbounded, k(n) is unbounded along a subsequence.
For 1<=k<=n, binom(n,k)=product_{i=0}^{k-1} (n-i)/(k-i) >= (n/k)^k; each factor is at least n/k because n>=k.
Along the subsequence where k tends to infinity, the exponent k/2 exceeds every fixed C. Therefore the explicit state is superpolynomial.
theorem.fixed_degree_other_horn: If d is fixed, M(n,d)=O(n^d), so the closure is polynomial. But polynomial-calculus degree lower bounds on bounded-width CNF families show that no fixed d is complete for UNSAT refutation. In particular expansion-based PC/PCR lower-bound frameworks yield families whose required refutation degree grows with n over fixed fields.

killed: Promote the v4.1 degree-3 Macaulay kernel to a universal polynomial SAT/UNSAT procedure merely by trying degree 4,5,6,... while explicitly keeping every squarefree monomial through the current degree.
Choose any unbounded degree cap d(n) and claim polynomial runtime while storing the complete V_d coefficient table.
Infer SAT from failure at any fixed degree.
not_killed: A compressed representation of unbounded-degree consequences whose dimension and operations are polynomial without one coordinate per monomial.
Formula-dependent quotienting that proves most high-degree monomials equivalent or irrelevant before expansion.
Non-Macaulay global certificates such as a new determinant/Pfaffian/minimax/blossom invariant.

next_target.name: E8_COMPRESSED_UNBOUNDED_DEGREE_OR_NONALGEBRAIC_GLOBAL_INVARIANT_V4_5
next_target.directive: Do not escalate explicit degree. Seek a polynomial-size quotient/circuit/state that can represent genuinely unbounded-degree global consequences and supports exact zero/contradiction testing plus witness reconstruction. It must survive existing multiplicative-quotient, Hankel-rank, noncommutative-rank, syndrome-hash and fixed-boundary barriers; otherwise switch to a nonalgebraic global contraction/minimax invariant.

sources: M. Miksa and J. Nordstrom, A Generalized Method for Proving Polynomial Calculus Degree Lower Bounds, Journal of the ACM 71(6), Article 37, 2024.
A. Alekhnovich and A. Razborov, Lower Bounds for Polynomial Calculus: Nonbinomial Case, Proc. Steklov Inst. Math. 242 (2003), 18-35.
